Title: Ishaan's Day

Cast

1. Ishaan - 11 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Kavita - 39 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Kavya - 9 years, friend
Look: glasses, blue dress

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
4. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Ishaan stands by the road. Kavita and Kavya stand near him.]

Kavita: "What lovely weather!"

[Ishaan rides his bicycle down the road.]

Ishaan: "That was fun!"

[Ishaan gets into the car.]

Kavita: "Really?"

[Ishaan gets on the bus.]

Kavita (happily): "This is amazing!"

[Ishaan gets off the school bus.]

Ishaan: "Mom, are you okay?"

[Ishaan hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Ishaan (excited): "Oh wow!"

Scene 2: The bedroom - Day

[Ishaan stands in the bedroom. Kavita and Kavya stand near him.]

Kavita: "What a nice place."

[Ishaan yawns loudly.]

Kavita: "Yes, of course."

[Ishaan goes to bed and falls asleep.]

Ishaan (gently): "Exactly right."

[Ishaan sits on the edge of the bed.]

Kavya (gently): "And then?"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Kavita and Kavya stand near him.]

Kavya: "Let's begin."

[Ishaan draws a picture of the house.]

Ishaan (softly): "Yes, all right."

[Ishaan slips and falls.]

Ishaan (happily): "Exactly right."

[It starts to rain.]

Ishaan: "I knew it!"

[Dry leaves fall from the trees.]

Ishaan (laughing): "Mom, listen!"

[Birds chirp in the trees.]

Ishaan: "What happened?"

Scene 4: The living room - Day

[Ishaan stands in the living room. Kavita stands near him.]

Ishaan: "What a nice place."

[Ishaan sweeps the floor with a broom.]

Ishaan: "I knew it!"

[Ishaan mops the floor.]

Ishaan (surprised): "That was fun!"

[Ishaan irons his school shirt.]

Ishaan: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
